blocks.text: Looking forward to your note on Friday. Short is good. I read the short ones twice.
One small request: end it with a line on what you need from me. Even if the answer is nothing this week. It's the line people tend to skip, and it's the only one I can actually do something with.
Separately, we're putting together a portfolio dinner next month. No date yet. I'll send one as soon as we have it, and I'd like you there.
